question: does the oracle asymmetry -- the finding that most of best-of-N's reported advantage over guided decoding is the ground-truth oracle rather than the selection -- replicate on a second, architecturally different generator?

prereg_lock.note: Frozen before any C33 measurement artefact existed -- before the pool was regenerated, not only before the decision stage.  The block from '## C33.0.1 Why this experiment exists' onward is copied verbatim into reports/section_c33_oracle_asymmetry_gen2.md; tests/test_oracle_asymmetry_gen2.py asserts the copy is byte-identical and that this file's mtime strictly precedes every C33 artefact.

generator.architecture: GPT-2, full softmax attention, byte-level BPE, 12 blocks
generator.comparison_generator: ibm-research/GP-MoLFormer-Uniq, linear attention, 46.8M params, atom-level vocabulary -- C27's

uncertainty: per-seed values and a seed-level t interval on 2 df (t_0.975,2 = 4.302653); no bootstrap anywhere in C33, C33.0.7

G1_pool_identity.rule: the regenerated `oracle_selected` curve must reproduce outputs/c31_bestofn_<prop>/n_sweep_metrics.json at every grid point and every generation seed, in hit rate and in tokens per returned molecule

G2_head_provenance.rule_as_preregistered: resolved head_file, file SHA-256, parameter-level SHA-256, checkpoint metadata, binner kind and parameters, interval-mask bin count, cross-checked against outputs/c31_heads/depth_<prop>.json for the same probe point and head seed
G2_head_provenance.pass_fail_criterion: parameter-level identity and metadata agreement -- NOT the file hash.  C33.0.4 G2 declares this change of criterion relative to C27 in advance.

c27_file_hash_criterion_failed_by_constr.what: one identical checkpoint dict saved twice under two different file names, in a temporary directory that is then deleted
c27_file_hash_criterion_failed_by_constr.conclusion: a FILE hash tests serialisation, not content: the file hashes differ (or agree only by the accident of equal names) while the tensors are identical.  C33.0.4 G2's pass/fail criterion is parameter-level identity plus metadata agreement; the file hash is recorded as evidence only.

G3_cost_identity.rule_a: within C33 all three arms select from one pool, so tokens per returned molecule must be identical across arms at every grid point
G3_cost_identity.rule_b: against C31, each re-priced guided cell's tokens_per_molecule_actual must equal the value recorded in its k_cell_metrics.json exactly, and C31's processed_tokens_actual mod (k+1) == 0 identity is re-checked

G4_n1_identity.rule: at N=1 there is one candidate and nothing to select, so all three arms must agree exactly with each other and with C31

G5_head_discriminates.rule: per anchor and per seed, the AUROC of the head's terminal-position P(y_final in I) for discriminating true hits among the 16,384 pool molecules; near chance is fixed as min over seeds < 0.55

G6_frozen_interval.rule: target_intervals.json and windows.json in outputs/c31_zinc50k/ are SHA-256'd and the (lo, hi, base_rate) triple used by C33 must equal the triple recorded in each C31 deployed k cell

windows.source: pooled generated-position distribution of the base model

F1.rule: the oracle asymmetry replicates on generator 2: for every anchor whose deployed-k2 cell has adv_oracle < 0, oracle_share >= 0.50

F2.rule: it replicates at C27's magnitude: every computable deployed-k2 oracle_share lies in [0.75, 1.0]

F3.rule: equalising information changes the arm count: n_arms_above_head_selected_curve > n_arms_above_oracle_selected_curve over the 30 cells

F4.rule: the head arm is not degenerate: on every anchor head_selected gains >= 0.02 absolute hit rate from N=1 to N=32

F5.rule: the diagnostic arm behaves as C27's did: on every anchor head_selected_at_75pct at every N >= 2 lies strictly between the N=1 base rate and head_selected at the same N

F6.rule: the honesty rule: any cell whose between-generation-seed sd exceeds the absolute value of its own mean advantage is reported as not resolved at three generation seeds; any anchor whose deployed-k2 adv_oracle t interval spans zero is reported as unresolved even where the point estimate is negative

Q1.statement: G1's maximum absolute hit-rate residual is exactly 0.0 on all three anchors

Q2.statement: G5's terminal-position pool AUROC exceeds 0.70 on all three anchors, and exceeds the 75%-position AUROC on all three

Q3.statement: F4 fires: head_selected gains >= 0.02 from N=1 to N=32 on all three anchors

Q4.statement: F1 fires on every anchor with a computable deployed-k2 share

Q5.statement: F2 fires: every computable deployed-k2 share is in [0.75, 1.00]

Q7.statement: the hbd_count deployed-k2 share is NOT computable, because C31 records that cell's advantage against the oracle curve as +0.0317

detail.oracle_share_status: not defined (advantage vs oracle curve is not negative)

Q8.statement: F5 fires on at most two of the three anchors

Q9.statement: the budget-matched gap at the deployed k=2 budget is smaller on generator 2 than C27's generator-1 gaps on at least two anchors

Q10.statement: no arm of C33 changes any C31 number: C33 re-prices C31's cells, re-runs none of them, and every C31 artefact is read-only
